race.comment: BLUE MOON SUMMIT (3) started at $10 last time and ran below expectations, finishing ninth and beaten 4.5 lengths at Echuca over 1000m. Finds the right race this time and can make amends. HEAD CAPITALIST (9) broke through for her maiden win over 1200m at Queanbeyan last time. Shaping up nicely and she is one of the main chances. KENNY'S SWANS (1) was in the money two starts back at Wagga but couldn't back it up last time when seventh, beaten 3 lengths, at Gundagai over 1400m. Nicely placed to bounce back. RUSSIAN GANGSTER (5) returns and is worth noting he was a winner on debut last time in. Drawn sticky but is worth a market watch.
